description.narrative: Oxfam in Laos Country office will be leading the initiative to conduct the National Dialogue. This event involved many sectors suchas: 1.) government from many different ministry, national assembly; 2.) Provate sectors: from Dam operators, Rubber Plant Companies; 3.) Researchers and Institutes;. This project is partnership with Green Community Alliance (GCA): in a non-profit association active in Laos since 2012. It strives to support community-based forest enterprises, and to promote the capacities, knowledge and information exchanges between community organizations, and to link community agendas to the national one. GCA focuses on empowering local communities around transparent and participatory natural resources governance. Under IJET, GCA will support the newly established Lao Natural Resources and River Network with formal registration, who in turn will perform the role of convening and setting the agenda among relevant stakeholders on water governance in Laos. They will do this through organizing various events such as talk shows and other media events related to the State management of water resources, and by being a leading voice in the sector.

participating-org.narrative:
Oxfam has had a presence in Lao PDR for longer than most INGOs, with both Oxfam in Belgium (OBE) and Oxfam Australia (OAU) beginning programming and establishing offices in the late 1980s. Oxfam’s vision is of a Laos in which all citizens – particularlywomen, the marginalised and discriminated groups – are able to claim their right to access opportunities and resources so as to overcome all forms of poverty and injustice.
Since 2015, the work of Oxfam in the country is governed by the Oxfam Country Strategy (2015-2019).We seek transformative changes in policies, practices and beliefs in ways that fundamentally improve the lives of poor and marginalised women and men, and ensure that all citizens have the same opportunities to enjoy their rights. Todo so, Oxfam focuses its work on four Domains of Change: Citizen Participation and Civil Society Development, Gender Justice, Resilient Communities and Sustainable Development, and Responsible Investment.
For this project, Oxfam in Laos will support theexpansion of the influencing work and public campaign on advocating for more inclusive social protection and access to social protection of the most marginalized workers. National public events will be organised, such Eliminate Violence Against Women Day(EVAW), and digital platforms will be used to socialize the information, and stir discussion and dialogue among rights holders, government stakeholders and policy makers. The campaigns will be implemented nationwide and in the provinces where Oxfam in Laos works. Target groups include marginalized workers, youth,women, CSOs as well as government stakeholders.
